bracketGoal: 3 Game Changers: Necropotence, Bolas's Citadel, Demonic Tutor
name: Doom Unrivaled
notes: One list, merged Nov 8, 2026 from: B3 main, Owned now, Doom+Ultron owned and optimal, last night's physical build, and every card discussed. Everything that isn't in the 100 is on Cards to add.

Plan: Doom taps several times a turn (Thousand-Year Elixir, Magewright's Stone, Umbral Mantle, Illusionist's Bracers, Rings of Brighthearth, Peter Parker's Camera) while Mesmeric Orb, Millstone, Altar of Dementia, Stargaze, Necropotence and Peer into the Abyss empty the library.

Shortcuts: Leveler (Buried Alive it into the graveyard, tutor it, or reanimate it with Reanimate, Animate Dead, Persist, The War in Heaven, Grim Reaper's Scythe; Zombie Infestation discards it on purpose) and Doomsday.

Backup: Ultron the Annihilator drains each opponent for every artifact that hits your graveyard. Fuel: Kingpin's Treasures, Genesis of the Daleks, Doombot Harbinger, Servo-Guards, Big Mother Mouser, Castle Doom; outlets: Deadly Dispute, Village Rites, Nasty End, Reclamation Specialist, Skullclamp, Altar. Psychosis Crawler and Exsanguinate close.
Bracket 3: exactly 3 Game Changers (Necropotence, Bolas's Citadel, Demonic Tutor). Rule 0: Doom + Leveler and Doomsday are near-two-card wins.
18 cards in this list aren't in your collection yet. The Owned build version swaps each for an owned stand-in so you can sleeve it now.
Equipment: Cranial Plating, Lashwrithe, Adaptive Omnitool. Mask of Memory is the 4th if you want one. Never copy Equipment with Ultron, Artificial Malevolence.
Timing: if Leveler enters during your upkeep (Rescue, Scythe tricks), tap Doom before your draw step.
Cards to add tags: owned, Borg (unopened), check (ownership unconfirmed), Big Wheels (moved there), wishlist (not owned), not legal (off-color).
Retired versions: B3+ sim, B4 sim, cEDH sim, Owned now, Doom+Ultron owned and optimal. All of their cards are in the 100 or on Cards to add.
Nov 10: Shred Memory in for Feed the Swarm, Splinter's Technique in for Read the Bones (both builds). Still 3 Game Changers.

Nov 12 sim (Owned build, exact card text from mtg-data; 4,000 games against a normal table and 3,000 against a hostile one, with removal modeled as random events; removal spells count as blanks). Win split: Doom + Leveler about 90% of wins, Doomsday about 7%, damage/drain 1-2%, natural empty library under 1%. That replaces the Nov 10 estimate (damage 25-35%). Win by turn 10: 69% normal table, 55% hostile.

Nov 12 sim, card values: the biggest are Leveler, Demonic Tutor, Splinter's Technique, Sol Ring, Diabolic Tutor, Doomsday, Howling Mine, Lightning Greaves, and every land (a 34th land is worth about +2%). At or below zero: Zombie Infestation, Psychosis Crawler, Big Mother Mouser, Codex Shredder, Kingpin, Peter Parker's Camera, Cranial Plating, Lashwrithe, Ultron, Artificial Malevolence. Ultron the Annihilator is about zero: the backup plan rarely wins before Leveler does.
Nov 12: the Owned build is now the speed build: 11 sim swaps applied (see its notes). Win by turn 8 went from 49% to 66%. The Best build is unchanged.

Nov 12 card-text checks: Kingpin makes Treasures once per turn, only when you sacrifice a creature. Rat King, Verminister reanimates (tap, sacrifice three Rats). Buried Alive finds creature cards only. Urn of Godfire costs 1. Death in the Family hits mana value 3 or less. Doombots, Servo-Guards, Harbinger, Age of Ultron tokens and Millikin get Ultron, Machine Overlord's bonus; Leaden Myr doesn't.

variants.name: Doom Unrivaled (Owned build)
notes: Plan: Doom + Leveler. Put Leveler onto the battlefield (cast it, tutor it, or bin and reanimate it) while Doom is untapped and protected, then tap Doom. Doomsday is the second route. Ultron the Annihilator is the long-game backup.

How to pilot (Nov 13 sim with opponents holding counterspells and removal): hold Doom until he can arrive protected. Cast him when Lightning Greaves, Swiftfoot Boots or Champion's Helm is on the battlefield and you can pay to equip it that turn, or when you can cast him, give him haste and get Leveler in the same turn. By turn 9 with neither, cast him anyway.

Only fire Leveler when Doom has shroud or hexproof. If no protection piece is on the battlefield, the first tutor finds one (Shred Memory can transmute for Greaves or Boots); the next finds Leveler. Cast Duress the turn before you go off. A countered Leveler isn't a loss: reanimate it.
Then let Leveler's trigger resolve and tap Doom immediately. Emergency only: if Doom is already tapped, untap next turn and tap him in your upkeep, before the draw step.

Sim at your kind of table: playing Doom on curve and comboing whenever possible won 57% (36% by turn 10), and opponents blew up the combo in 17% of games. Holding Doom and only comboing protected won 79% (58% by turn 10), with the combo blown up in 1%. At a light table holding costs about 5% of turn-8 wins but still wins more overall. Greaves, Boots and Champion's Helm together are worth over 50% of wins under this plan.

Nov 12 swaps, round 1: Swamp for Zombie Infestation, The Cruelty of Gix for Big Mother Mouser, Sign in Blood for Codex Shredder, Arc Reactor for Peter Parker's Camera, Isolinear Processor for Cranial Plating, Rescue from the Underworld for Kingpin. Round 2: Hedron Crawler for Psychosis Crawler, Read the Bones for Genesis of the Daleks, Zombify for Ultron, Artificial Malevolence, Shredder's Revenge for Millstone, Cabal Ritual for Gwenom.

Nov 13: Fellwar Stone in for Lashwrithe. Murmuring Volume in for Project Deathlok Soldier as the placeholder for Vampiric Tutor. Duress in for Idol of Oblivion; Champion's Helm (owned) in for Reclamation Specialist (Borg, unopened). Chromatic Star in for Hedron Crawler (not owned). Duress + Helm tested about +3-5% at your kind of table.
Nov 18: Psychosis Crawler back in (it's in the physical deck), so it's now in both builds. Chromatic Star stays; Shredder's Revenge (placeholder-grade draw) is out instead. Not re-simmed.

Nov 18: Demonic Tutor out for now, Chromatic Sphere in as the stand-in. Demonic Tutor was the sim's second most valuable card; put it back when you can. Eumidian Hatchery in for a Swamp. Tainted Pact (newly owned) stays on Cards to add until the land swap cuts duplicate basics: with ~28 Swamps it usually stops after about 6 cards, exiling everything it passes.
To pick up: Hedron Crawler (about $0.20), maybe. It's a 2-mana artifact creature that taps for {C}. In the latest sim it's worth about the same as Chromatic Star, so it's optional.

Game Changers to add (not owned yet): Vampiric Tutor replaces Murmuring Volume; Ancient Tomb replaces a Swamp. With Demonic Tutor that makes 3, the Bracket 3 maximum. Necropotence and Bolas's Citadel tested negative here, so they aren't the picks for this build.
34 lands (28 Swamps + Eumidian Hatchery). A 35th land adds nothing more.
Lash of the Balrog is in for Bitter Triumph until you open the Borg precon. Rogue's Passage: loose copy from another set (Nov 12).

Isolinear Processor's mana only pays for artifact spells and artifact abilities; Leveler, Arc Reactor and equip costs all count. Champion's Helm gives hexproof only to a legendary creature, which Doom is.
Bracket 3 either way: Bracket 2 expects no Game Changers, few tutors, no two-card game-enders and games of 8+ turns. Mention Doom + Leveler and Doomsday before the game.
Earlier: Nov 10 Millikin, Victimize, Resentful Revelation, Breach the Multiverse and Leaden Myr in; Nov 11 Risky Research in for Read the Bones (Read the Bones back Nov 12).
Nov 20: the Unique Pact version is the same 65 nonland cards with Tainted Pact for Chromatic Sphere and a 34-land base where every name appears once. It simmed about 0.4 turns faster than this build.

notes: Every card name appears once, so Tainted Pact never stops on a duplicate. Win: with Doom untapped and not summoning sick, cast Pact, take nothing until the library is empty, then tap Doom. Never add a second copy of anything (a second Swamp breaks it). Snow-Covered Swamp is a different name from Swamp.
Pact as a tutor: it finds anything (Leveler, Doomsday, Greaves), but every card it passes is exiled. Skipping Leveler to find Greaves loses Leveler.

Lands (34). Already owned (9): Swamp, Vault of Whispers, Eumidian Hatchery, Spymaster's Vault, Memorial to Folly, Thriving Moor, Evolving Wilds, Castle Doom, Rogue's Passage; plus Unclaimed Territory (name Villain). From the unopened Borg precon (4): Command Tower, Spire of Industry, Path of Ancestry, Exotic Orchard.

To buy (20, about $15 at the cheapest printings, Nov 12 prices): Snow-Covered Swamp, Castle Locthwain, Cabal Pit, Hive of the Eye Tyrant, Barad-dûr, Ifnir Deadlands, Leechridden Swamp, Bojuka Bog, Mortuary Mire, The Dross Pits, Ebon Stronghold, Barren Moor, Polluted Mire, Hagra Mauling, Reliquary Tower, War Room, Buried Ruin, Darksteel Citadel, Mirrex, Treasure Vault.

Nov 20 sim (10,000 games, Bracket 3 table): today's Owned build wins by turn 8 57.7%, by turn 10 73.7%; this version 62.8% and 78.1%, about 0.37 turns faster. At a Bracket 4 table about 5 points better by turns 8 and 10. Pact won about 37% of games. Pact with the 28 Swamps did nothing; the singleton lands without Pact were 0.5 turns slower. Stand-ins and the new lands are lightly modeled.

Nov 20 sim, lands: every land in this base is worth about the same (0.08-0.16 turns each), so buy the cheapest first. Upgrades: an untapped black land is the whole gain. Cabal Coffers and Phyrexian Tower add nothing here, and Hall of the Bandit Lord barely helps.
Bracket 3 with 0 Game Changers. Tell the table about Doom + Leveler, Doom + Tainted Pact and Doomsday before the game.
